subject.title: fix(agents): use currentAttemptAssistant for incomplete-turn classification

question: Is the source-level before/after terminal proof sufficient for this message-delivery classifier fix, or should maintainers require a live channel reproduction before merge?
rationale: The code path and regression tests support the fix, but the user-visible failure was reported through a live channel path that this review did not rerun.

options.title: Accept Source-Level Proof
options.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers accept the terminal fixture and regression tests as enough for this classifier-only runtime fix.

options.title: Require Live Channel Proof
options.body: Pause merge until a real configured channel run demonstrates `update_plan` followed by a `stopReason=stop` final answer being delivered.

recommendation.title: Accept Source-Level Proof
recommendation.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers accept the terminal fixture and regression tests as enough for this classifier-only runtime fix.

likelyOwner.reason: He recently owned the terminal-classifier simplification in this helper and is best positioned to judge whether source-level proof is sufficient.
